enDef: an object that you use to protect yourself against rain or hot sun. It consists of a circular folding frame covered in cloth.

example.en: It started to rain, so Tricia stopped to put up her umbrella.
example.cn: 开始下雨了，所以特里西娅停下来撑起雨伞。

cn: [understood-understood] 理解， 懂； 了解， 意识到； 认为， 以为
enDef: to know the meaning of what someone is telling you, or the language that they speak

example.en: She doesn’t understand English.
example.cn: 她不懂英语。

cn: 不快乐的； 不幸的， 悲惨的
enDef: not happy

example.en: If you’re so unhappy, why don’t you change jobs?
example.cn: 你要是那么不开心，为什么不换个工作呢？

enDef: used to mean ‘on’ or ‘onto’

example.en: an honour bestowed upon the association
example.cn: 授予该协会的荣誉

enDef: an educational institution at the highest level, where you study for a degree

example.en: Why do you go to university?
example.cn: 你为什么上大学呢？

enDef: not known to you

example.en: a crowd of unfamiliar faces
example.cn: 一群陌生的面孔

cn: 叔叔；伯父；伯伯；舅父；姨丈；姑父
enDef: the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

example.en: I went to stay with my uncle and aunt for a few days.
example.cn: 我去和叔叔婶婶住了几天。

enDef: not important

example.en: unimportant details
example.cn: 无关紧要的细枝末节

enDef: if something happens until a particular time, it continues and then stops at that time

example.en: The ticket is valid until March.
example.cn: 这张票的有效期一直到 3 月份。

cn: 有用的，有益的；有帮助的
enDef: helping you to do or get what you want

example.en: useful information
example.cn: 有用的信息

enDef: not able to do something

example.en: The military may feel unable to hand over power to a civilian president next year.
example.cn: 军方可能觉得无法在明年把政权移交给一位民选总统。

cn: 不舒服的； 不舒适的； 感到不安的， 不自在的
enDef: not feeling physically comfortable, or not making you feel comfortable

example.en: This sofa is so uncomfortable.
example.cn: 这张沙发太不舒服了。

enDef: under the earth’s surface

example.en: This animal spends most of its life underground.
example.cn: 这种动物一生中的大部分时间都待在地下。

cn: 习惯的；二手的，使用过的

example.en: I do the dishes every day, so I’m used to it.
example.cn: 我每天洗盘子，所以习惯了。

cn: 单位，单元；装置；[军] 部队；部件
enDef: an amount of something used as a standard of measurement

example.en: The man is in the hospital’s intensive care unit.
example.cn: 那名男子在医院的重症监护室。

cn: 在…下面， 在…底下； 少于； 低于； 在…管辖下， 在…影响下
enDef: below or at a lower level than something, or covered by something

example.en: Wendy had hidden the box under her bed.
example.cn: 温迪把盒子藏在了自己的床底下。

cn: 心烦的， 苦恼的； 不适的； 心烦的， 苦恼的； 不适的
enDef: unhappy and worried because something unpleasant or disappointing has happened

example.en: You’re not still upset with me, are you?
example.cn: 你不是还在生我的气吧？

cn: 使人不愉快的， 厌恶的； 煞风景的； 不和的， 不客气的
enDef: not pleasant or enjoyable

example.en: an unpleasant experience
example.cn: 不愉快的经历

cn: 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的
enDef: extremely unattractive and unpleasant to look at

example.en: a very ugly man
example.cn: 非常丑陋的男子

enDef: if you use a particular tool, method, service, ability etc, you do something with that tool, by means of that method etc, for a particular purpose

example.en: Can I use your phone?
example.cn: 我可以用一下你的电话吗？

example.en: The editor killed a few useless lines.
example.cn: 编辑删掉了几行无用的文字。

enDef: used to say that something will happen or be true if something else does not happen or is not true

example.en: Unless some extra money is found, the theatre will close.
example.cn: 要是不能找到更多资金，剧院将要关闭。

enDef: being the same in all its parts or among all its members

example.en: Grade A eggs must be of uniform size.
example.cn: A 级鸡蛋必须大小相同。

enDef: not kind or friendly

example.en: The old man looked cross and unfriendly.
example.cn: 老人看上去生气了，很不友好。

enDef: towards a higher place or position

example.en: We walked slowly up the hill.
example.cn: 我们慢慢地爬上山。

enDef: likely to make you ill

example.en: unhealthy living conditions
example.cn: 不利于健康的生活环境

cn: 在楼上，向楼上；上楼；往楼上
enDef: towards or on an upper floor in a building

example.en: I went upstairs and had a shower.
example.cn: 我上楼冲了个澡。

enDef: happening, done, or existing most of the time or in most situations

example.en: Make a cheese sauce in the usual way.
example.cn: 按通常的做法做奶酪酱。

enDef: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people

example.en: Please help us.
example.cn: 请帮助我们。

enDef: Something that exists or happens underwater exists or happens below the surface of the ocean, a river, or a lake

example.en: ...giant submarines able to travel at high speeds underwater.
example.cn: …能在水下高速行驶的巨型潜艇。

cn: 不平常的， 少有的； 独特的， 与众不同的
enDef: different from what is usual or normal

example.en: an unusual feature
example.cn: 不寻常的特点

enDef: very important and needing to be dealt with immediately

example.en: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
example.cn: 他急需治疗。

enDef: used to talk about what happens on most occasions or in most situations

example.en: Women usually live longer than men.
example.cn: 女人通常比男人长寿。

enDef: used in the names of some clubs or organizations

example.en: the British Golf Union
example.cn: 英国高尔夫球协会

enDef: if different people or organizations unite, or if something unites them, they join together in order to achieve something

example.en: Our goal is to unite the opposition parties and defeat the President.
example.cn: 我们的目标是联合各反对党挫败总统。

enDef: feeling doubt about something

example.en: My whole future now seemed uncertain.
example.cn: 现在我的前途似乎是个未知数。

cn: 不幸的；令人遗憾的；不成功的
enDef: someone who is unfortunate has something bad happen to them

example.en: When we entered the room, the teacher was yelling at some unfortunate student.
example.cn: 我们进教室的时候，老师正在对着一个倒霉的学生吼叫。

enDef: if something used to happen, it happened regularly or all the time in the past, but does not happen now

example.en: He used to go to our school.
example.cn: 他曾在我们学校就读。

cn: 不安全的；危险的；不安稳的
enDef: dangerous or likely to cause harm

example.en: The building is unsafe.
example.cn: 那栋大楼不安全。

cn: 不真实的；不合标准的；不忠实的；不正当的
enDef: not based on facts that are correct

example.en: allegations that are totally untrue
example.cn: 完全不能成立的指控

enDef: very good, successful, or impressive

example.en: The opportunities are unbelievable.
example.cn: 机会好得令人难以相信。

enDef: to draw a line under a word to show that it is important

example.en: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
example.cn: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

enDef: not wanting to do something and refusing to do it

example.en: an unwilling helper
example.cn: 勉强来帮忙的人

enDef: completely different from a particular person or thing

example.en: Tammy was unlike any other woman I have ever known.
example.cn: 塔米和我认识的其他女人都不一样。

enDef: clothes that you wear next to your body under your other clothes

example.en: You just need to take a change of underwear.
example.cn: 你只需带一套换洗的内衣。

enDef: moving or pointing towards a higher position

example.en: Pointing upwards, he indicated a large nest high in the tree.
example.cn: 他朝上指指，示意树上高处有个大鸟窝。

enDef: all space, including all the stars and planets

example.en: Einstein's equations showed the universe to be expanding.
example.cn: 爱因斯坦的方程式表明宇宙正在扩大。

enDef: If someone moves or looks upward, they move or look up towards a higher place

example.en: They climbed upward along the steep cliffs surrounding the village.
example.cn: 他们沿着环绕村庄的陡峭悬崖向上爬。

enDef: unusually good and special

example.en: a unique opportunity to study these rare creatures
example.cn: 研究这些珍稀动物的难得机会

enDef: to make something more modern in the way it looks or operates

example.en: plans to update manufacturing procedures
example.cn: 更新生产流程的计划

enDef: the number of people in a particular country or area who cannot get a job

example.en: a town where there is high unemployment
example.cn: 高失业率城镇

enDef: a political situation in which people protest or behave violently

example.en: There is growing unrest throughout the country.
example.cn: 全国各地日益动荡不安。

enDef: to strongly suggest that someone does something

example.en: The charity urged quick action.
example.cn: 慈善机构敦促迅速采取行动。

enDef: to open something that is tied, fastened or wrapped

example.en: The screws can be undone by hand.
example.cn: 这些螺丝可以用手拧开。

enDef: to accept that you are responsible for a piece of work, and start to do it

example.en: She undertook the task of monitoring the elections.
example.cn: 她承担了监督选举的任务。

enDef: used when you are mentioning a fact that you wish was not true

example.en: Unfortunately, you were out when we called.
example.cn: 很遗憾，我们来的时候你出去了。

enDef: involving everyone in the world or in a particular group

example.en: free universal healthcare
example.cn: 免费的全民保健制度

enDef: relating to towns and cities

example.en: unemployment in urban areas
example.cn: 城市地区的失业状况

cn: 难以忍受的；承受不住的
enDef: too unpleasant, painful, or annoying to deal with

example.en: The pain was almost unbearable.
example.cn: 那疼痛几乎难以忍受。

cn: 不适宜的；不合格的；不健康的
enDef: not in a good physical condition

example.en: She never gets any exercise – she must be really unfit.
example.cn: 她从不锻炼——身体一定很不好。

enDef: if a story unfolds, or if someone unfolds it, it is told

example.en: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
example.cn: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

cn: 不公平的， 不公正的
enDef: not right or fair, especially because not everyone has an equal opportunity

example.en: an unfair advantage
example.cn: 不公平的优势

cn: 专心的；专一的；未分开的；完整的
enDef: complete

example.en: I’ll give the matter my undivided attention.
example.cn: 我会全力关注此事。

cn: [法] 未婚的；单身的；独身的
enDef: not married

example.en: unmarried mothers
example.cn: 未婚母亲

cn: 无条件的；绝对的；无限制的
enDef: not limited by or depending on any conditions

example.en: the unconditional release of all political prisoners
example.cn: 所有政治犯的无条件释放

enDef: in a higher position than something else

example.en: the upper lip
example.cn: 上唇

enDef: an unofficial or informal agreement

example.en: We had an understanding that Jean-Claude should never be mentioned.
example.cn: 我们有一个共识，永远不提让－克洛德。

enDef: not having a successful result or not achieving what you wanted to achieve

example.en: an unsuccessful attempt to climb Qomolangma
example.cn: 攀登珠穆朗玛峰的失败尝试

cn: 不省人事的， 无意识的
enDef: unable to see, move, feel etc in the normal way because you are not conscious

example.en: She was found alive but unconscious.
example.cn: 她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

enDef: someone or something that uses a product, service etc

example.en: road users
example.cn: 道路使用者

cn: 未知的；陌生的，默默无闻的
enDef: not known about

example.en: The murderer’s identity remains unknown.
example.cn: 杀人凶手身份仍然不明。

cn: 联合国（United Nations）；硝酸铀铣（Uranyl Nitrate）

example.en: But we have the same problem in UK.
example.cn: 而在我们英国，也有同样的问题。

cn: 直到最近的， 现代的； 跟上时代的
enDef: modern or fashionable

example.en: ...the most up-to-date information available on foods today.
example.cn: …今日有关食品的最新消息。

enDef: finally, after everything else has been done or considered

example.en: Ultimately, the decision rests with the child’s parents.
example.cn: 最终，决定权在这孩子的父母手中。

example.en: You have to become awfully large to be unaffordable -- there's lots of cash, lots of capital out there for acquisitions.
example.cn: 制药业者坐拥很多现金,进行收购的资本雄厚,你必须变成让人买不起的超大公司.

enDef: If you undermine someone's efforts or undermine their chances of achieving something, you behave in a way that makes them less likely to succeed

example.en: The continued fighting threatens to undermine efforts to negotiate an agreement.
example.cn: 持续的战斗有可能破坏通过谈判达成协议的努力。

enDef: the way that your parents care for you and teach you to behave when you are growing up

example.en: Mike had had a strict upbringing.
example.cn: 迈克从小家教很严。

enDef: if you undergo a change, an unpleasant experience etc, it happens to you or is done to you

example.en: The country has undergone massive changes recently.
example.cn: 这个国家最近经历了巨大的变化。

enDef: a service such as gas or electricity provided for people to use

example.en: Does your rent include utilities?
example.cn: 你的房租包括公用事业费吗？

enDef: Unintended results were not planned to happen, although they happened

example.en: ...the unintended consequences of human action.
example.cn: ...人类行为无心的结果。

example.en: This is undoubtedly important.
example.cn: 这无疑是重要的。

enDef: to think that someone or something is less important or valuable than they really are

example.en: Society undervalues staying at home and looking after children.
example.cn: 社会低估了待在家里照看孩子的意义。

enDef: someone’s ultimate aim is their main and most important aim, that they hope to achieve in the future

example.en: The ultimate outcome of the experiment cannot be predicted.
example.cn: 试验的最后结果无法预测。

enDef: to remove the cover from something

example.en: When the seedlings sprout, uncover the tray.
example.cn: 幼苗发芽后，揭开盘上的遮盖物。

enDef: a student at college or university, who is working for their first degree

example.en: second-year undergraduates
example.cn: 大学二年级学生

enDef: Underneath is also an adverb

example.en: He has on his jeans and a long-sleeved blue denim shirt with a white T-shirt underneath.
example.cn: 他身穿牛仔裤和一件蓝色长袖粗斜纹棉布衬衫，里面还有件白色T恤衫。

enDef: worried or slightly afraid because you think that something bad might happen

example.en: She eventually fell into an uneasy sleep.
example.cn: 她终于睡着了，但睡得并不踏实。

enDef: used to describe something that is surprising because you were not expecting it

example.en: The experiment produced some unexpected results.
example.cn: 这次试验产生了一些意想不到的结果。

enDef: when a group of people or countries agree or are joined together

example.en: economic unity
example.cn: 经济统一

enDef: not likely to happen

example.en: Donna might be able to come tomorrow, but it’s very unlikely.
example.cn: 唐娜明天也许能来，不过这可能性很小。

enDef: to remove a load from a vehicle, ship etc

example.en: Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly.
example.cn: 从小船上卸下所有的货物并彻底地清洗。

enDef: standing or sitting straight up

example.en: Katie was still awake, sitting bolt upright(= sitting with her back very straight ) staring at the television.
example.cn: 凯蒂还醒着，坐得笔直，眼睛盯着电视。

enDef: the way that words are used in a language

example.en: a book on modern English usage
example.cn: 关于现代英语用法的书

enDef: to use something for a particular purpose

example.en: We must consider how best to utilize what resources we have.
example.cn: 我们必须考虑怎样充分利用现有的资源。

enDef: You can use utmost to emphasize the importance or seriousness of something or to emphasize the way that it is done

example.en: It is a matter of the utmost urgency to find out what has happened to these people.
example.cn: 当务之急是弄清楚这些人出了什么事。

enDef: complete – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong

example.en: That’s utter nonsense!
example.cn: 真是一派胡言！

enDef: ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people, but is responsible for making your skin darker when you are in the sun

example.en: The sun's ultraviolet rays are responsible for both tanning and burning.
example.cn: 太阳的紫外线是皮肤晒黑和晒伤的原因。

enDef: a heavy white metal that is radioactive and is used to produce nuclear power and nuclear weapons. It is a chemical element: symbol U

example.en: The fuel was enriched with uranium 235 for the nuclear reactor.
example.cn: 核反应堆的燃料被铀235浓缩。

enDef: not varying; the same in all parts and at all times

example.en: The principles were applied uniformly across all the departments.
example.cn: 这些原则统一适用于所有部门。

enDef: without any limit

example.en: The system can support an unlimited number of users.
example.cn: 该系统可以支持无限多的用户。

enDef: not yet paid

example.en: unpaid bills
example.cn: 未付的账单

cn: 使联合， 统一； 使相同， 使一致
enDef: if you unify two or more parts or things, or if they unify, they are combined to make a single unit

example.en: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
example.cn: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。

enDef: Utopian is used to describe political or religious philosophies which claim that it is possible to build a new and perfect society in which everyone is happy

example.en: His was a utopian vision of nature in its purest form.
example.cn: 他对大自然的看法是一种最纯粹的乌托邦式看法。

enDef: not having made a decision about something important

example.en: After college she was still undecided as to what career she wanted to pursue.
example.cn: 大学毕业后她仍无法决定自己要追求什么事业。

enDef: to think or guess that something is smaller, cheaper, easier etc than it really is

example.en: None of us should ever underestimate the degree of difficulty women face in career advancement.
example.cn: 我们谁都不应低估妇女在职业发展中所面临的困难程度。

enDef: a project, organization etc that is underfunded has not been given enough money to be effective

example.en: For years we have argued that the FDA is underfunded.
example.cn: 数年来我们一直在讲食品及药物管理局经费不足。

enDef: The underlying features of an object, event, or situation are not obvious, and it may be difficult to discover or reveal them

example.en: To stop a problem you have to understand its underlying causes.
example.cn: 要解决问题，你得了解其潜在原因。

enDef: an important job, piece of work, or activity that you are responsible for

example.en: Starting a new business can be a risky undertaking.
example.cn: 创办新企业有时是一件有风险的事情。

example.en: The place is rife with smugglers, dealers, undocumented immigrants, and slaves.
example.cn: 这里到处都是走私者、交易商、无证移民甚至奴隶。

enDef: morally unacceptable

example.en: unethical medical practices
example.cn: 不道德的医疗行为

enDef: not smooth, flat, or level

example.en: She walked back carefully over the uneven ground.
example.cn: 她小心翼翼地从凹凸不平的地面上走回来。

enDef: created from more than one part, group etc

example.en: a unified approach
example.cn: 统一的方法

enDef: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before

example.en: Such a move is rare, but not unprecedented.
example.cn: 这样的举动少见，但并非从来没有过。

enDef: unrealistic ideas or hopes are not reasonable or sensible

example.en: Some parents have totally unrealistic expectations of teachers.
example.cn: 有些家长对老师抱着完全不切实际的期望。

enDef: likely to change sud­denly and become worse

example.en: The political situation is still very unstable.
example.cn: 政局依然非常动荡。

enDef: working very hard for a long period of time in order to do something – used to show approval

example.en: untiring efforts to help the homeless
example.cn: 帮助无家可归者的不懈努力

enDef: someone who is untrustworthy cannot be trusted

example.en: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
example.cn: 我觉得他肤浅、虚荣，并不值得信赖。

enDef: Urbanization is the process of creating cities or towns in country areas

example.en: Much of this, she says, is due to increased urbanization.
example.cn: 而这些，主要是由于不断增加的都市化造成的。

example.en: For someone to realize the value of information, you need to organize data to permit rapid discovery and utilization.
example.cn: 要使某人实现信息的价值，您需要相应地组织数据以允许快速的发现和利用。

enDef: a lot of noise or angry protest about something

example.en: The announcement caused uproar in the crowd.
example.cn: 公告在人群中引起了一阵骚动。

enDef: unbiased information, opinions, advice etc is fair because the person giving it is not influenced by their own or other people’s opinions

example.en: We aim to provide a service that is balanced and unbiased.
example.cn: 我们的目标是提供一种公平公正的服务。

enDef: a thing such as a knife, spoon etc that you use when you are cooking

example.en: kitchen utensils
example.cn: 厨房用具

enDef: by everyone

example.en: ...a universally accepted point of view.
example.cn: …一个被普遍接受的观点。

enDef: completely – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong

example.en: You look utterly miserable.
example.cn: 你看起来很痛苦。

enDef: to make a computer, machine, or piece of software better and able to do more things

example.en: Helicopters have been upgraded and modernized.
example.cn: 直升机已经升级并且装上现代化设备。

enDef: not having enough knowledge or information

example.en: Parents were left anxious, uninformed, and isolated.
example.cn: 家长们忧心忡忡，不知道情况到底如何，感到孤立无援。

enDef: to emphasize the fact that something is important or true

example.en: The Labour Department figures underscore the shaky state of the economic recovery.
example.cn: 劳工部的数字突出显示了经济复苏的不稳定。

example.en: I brushed up against him unintentionally.
example.cn: 我无意中碰了他一下。

enDef: to unfasten the lock on a door, box etc

example.en: to unlock the door
example.cn: 打开门锁

enDef: to defend or support a law, system, or principle so that it continues to exist

example.en: We have a duty to uphold the law.
example.cn: 维护法律是我们的责任。

enDef: harmful substances that are untreated have not been made safe

example.en: untreated sewage
example.cn: 未经处理过的污水

enDef: not having the right knowledge, experience, or education to do something

example.en: unqualified staff
example.cn: 不合格的员工

enDef: to take the knots out of something, or unfasten something that has been tied

example.en: Peter untied his shoelaces.
example.cn: 彼得解开鞋带。

enDef: (of sounds) higher than humans can hear

example.en: ultrasonic waves
example.cn: 超声波

enDef: not fair or sensible

example.en: I think he’s being unreasonable.
example.cn: 我认为他是在无理取闹。

enDef: not welcome or wanted because they may affect a situation or person in a bad way

example.en: punishment of undesirable behaviour
example.cn: 对不良行为的惩罚

enDef: a unanimous decision, vote, agreement etc is one in which all the people involved agree

example.en: It was decided by a unanimous vote that the school should close.
example.cn: 关闭学校是大家一致通过的决定。

example.en: The one thing that never crosses the minds of our elite is to utilise local talent, local enterprise, local money to build Pakistan.
example.cn: 有一件事从来没有穿过我们精英的头脑，那就是利用本地人才，本地企业，本地资金来建设巴基斯坦。

enDef: to be the cause of something, or be the basic thing from which something develops

example.en: the one basic principle that underlies all of the party’s policies
example.cn: 贯穿该党各项政策的那一条基本原则

cn: 无双的， 无比的， 空前的
enDef: bigger, better, or worse than anything else

example.en: an achievement unparalleled in sporting history
example.cn: 体育史上空前的成就

cn: 漠不关心的； 不烦恼的
enDef: not worried about something because you think it does not affect you

example.en: Paul was unconcerned about what he had done.
example.cn: 保罗对自己所做过的事情并不在意。

enDef: not prejudiced or biased; impartial

example.en: Narrator: This is a tale about an unprejudiced heart, and how it changed our valley forever.
example.cn: 叙述者：故事讲述的是一颗毫无偏见的心是怎样改变我们这个山谷的。

example.en: ...underlings who do the dirty work.
example.cn: ...干肮脏勾当的走卒们。

enDef: if something, especially something bad, goes undetected, no one notices it

example.en: The thieves escaped undetected through a basement window.
example.cn: 那些盗贼从地下室的窗户神不知鬼不觉地逃走了。

enDef: if you unravel threads, string etc, or if they unravel, they stop being twisted together

example.en: Detectives are still trying to unravel the mystery surrounding his death.
example.cn: 侦探们仍在试图解开他的死亡之谜。

example.en: The rumours will do untold damage to his reputation.
example.cn: 这些谣言会给他的名声造成无法估计的损害。

enDef: the process of keeping something in good condition

example.en: Poorer people find it hard to pay for their pet’s upkeep.
example.cn: 经济不宽裕的人难以负担养宠物的开销。

cn: 打开， 解开； 除去包装
enDef: to remove the paper, plastic etc that is around something

example.en: Brigitte was unwrapping her birthday presents.
example.cn: 布丽吉特正在拆她的生日礼物。

cn: 向上， 往上； 上坡； 艰难地
enDef: towards the top of a hill

example.en: The road twists uphill.
example.cn: 这条路弯弯曲曲通向山上。

cn: 无敌的， 不可战胜的
enDef: a team, player etc that is unbeatable cannot be defeated

example.en: carpets at unbeatable prices
example.cn: 价格最优惠的地毯

cn: 揭去面纱或覆盖物； 揭幕； 首次公开、 揭露或展示
enDef: to remove the cover from something, especially as part of a formal ceremony

example.en: The statue was unveiled by the Queen.
example.cn: 这尊雕塑由女王揭幕。

enDef: not spoiled by any mistake or bad behaviour

example.en: a law firm with an unblemished reputation
example.cn: 声誉良好的律师事务所

enDef: not noticing or realizing what is happening

example.en: For my unconquerable soul.
example.cn: 不可征服的灵魂。

enDef: not included on an official list

example.en: unregistered land
example.cn: 未注册的土地

enDef: an undisguised feeling is clearly shown and not hidden

example.en: There was undisguised contempt in his voice.
example.cn: 他的语气中带着不加掩饰的轻蔑。

cn: 较远的； 不可告人的， 隐秘的， 秘密的

example.en: He’s just being nice. I don’t think he has any ulterior motives.
example.cn: 他就是好心，我不认为他别有用心。

cn: 顽强的； 坚硬的； 不能弯曲的， 坚固的
enDef: not willing to change your ideas or beliefs

example.en: an unyielding resistance to change
example.cn: 固执己见，不愿改变

example.en: Something that can only be seen in America: In the landscaped, ultraclean high-technology parks of northern Orange County there is a personal computer company that seven years ago did not exist.
example.cn: 只有在美国才会出现这种情况：在北部桔县环境作过美化的、超净的高科技园区，有家7年前尚不存在的个人电脑公司。

cn: 可以理解的， 能懂的； 可同情的
enDef: understandable behaviour, reactions etc seem normal and reasonable because of the situation you are in

example.en: It is understandable that parents are angry, and looking for someone to blame.
example.cn: 父母生气了想找个人出气，这是可以理解的。

enDef: a threat saying that if someone does not do what you want by a particular time, you will do something to punish them

example.en: The club gave him an ultimatum – either he apologized, or he would be expelled from the team.
example.cn: 俱乐部给他下了最后通牒——要么道歉，要么等着被开除出队。

enDef: not good enough or not acceptable

example.en: an unsatisfactory situation
example.cn: 让人不满意的状况

cn: 犹豫， 迟疑； 不确定； 无把握
enDef: when you feel doubt about what will happen

example.en: Times of great change are also times of uncertainty.
example.cn: 发生巨大变革的时期也是动荡的时期。

cn: 用言语表达， 讲话； 话语， 言语， 言论
enDef: something you say

example.en: Politicians are judged by their public utterances.
example.cn: 人们根据政治家公开的言论来评判他们。

cn: 不显著的， 不引人注目的； 不张扬的
enDef: not easily noticed

example.en: The staff are trained to be unobtrusive.
example.cn: 员工们受过训练要保持低调。

cn: 加固…的基础； 加强， 巩固
enDef: to give strength or support to something and to help it succeed

example.en: the theories that underpin his teaching method
example.cn: 支持他的教学方法的理论

example.en: The two sides have also pledged to enhance cooperation in tourism, and the protection and utilisation of cultural heritage.
example.cn: 双方承诺在旅游、文化遗产保护和利用等领域加强交流合作。

enDef: dirty and likely to cause disease

example.en: unsanitary conditions
example.cn: 不卫生的环境

cn: 给保险；同意赔款(海上保险)
enDef: if an insurance company underwrites an insurance contract, it agrees to pay for any damage or loss that happens

example.en: The government has agreed to underwrite the project with a grant of £5 million.
example.cn: 政府同意拨款 500 万英镑资助该项目。

enDef: more than is reasonable, suitable, or necessary

example.en: De Gaulle felt that America had undue influence in Europe.
example.cn: 戴高乐感到美国在欧洲影响力过大。

enDef: moving in a way that does not look graceful

example.en: a tall ungainly teenager
example.cn: 一个动作笨拙的高个子少年

enDef: a unilateral action or decision is done by only one of the groups involved in a situation

example.en: a unilateral declaration of independence
example.cn: 单方面宣布独立
